notes:
Top-level: early-stage company building an enterprise-grade VS Code copilot extension used inside developer workflows (code completion, inline suggestions, unit-test scaffolding). Hiring/engineer-heavy org; care about latency and deterministic behavior.

Summary of needs:
- Streaming, low-latency completions (inline suggestions appear while typing). Target: median suggestion RTT <= 60ms, p95 <= 150ms for short completions.
- Support for model/version pinning per workspace and per-team; want ability to pin a stable LLM for CI vs. use newer experimental models for R&D team.
- Fine-grained rate limits and auth integration: use internal API gateway + SSO. Token quotas per-seat and burst policies.
- Offline/on-prem option for regulated vertical (legal team): ability to run model in air-gapped environment for a small set of repos.
- Audit logs + retention + KMS for keys. Data residency requirement: primary customer code must stay in NA region for enterprise customers.
